messages:
Priya R: Heads-up - Qonto asked for per-route cost breakdown + deterministic 99th-percentile trace capture for a small set of hot routes pre-GA. They said: 'we need to detect cost regressions early'.

Alex M: Clarify - deterministic 99th only for top routes or sampling + full capture on anomaly triggers?

Priya R: Deterministic 99th for top 10 routes by traffic. Not full global trace capture (they're sensitive to cost).

Samir K: That's doable. We can enable full KV/trace dumps for those routes during a short canary window. Need to estimate token/trace delta.

Elaine: Quick estimate: capturing full payload for 0.1% of requests at peak adds ~+12% token usage for affected routes. To be deterministic at the 99th we need higher coverage but for a short window its manageable.

Alex M: Proposal: 24h deterministic capture window for the 10 routes, otherwise default 0.1% sampling. Keeps overall cost bounded.

Priya R: Also asking for per-route line-item in console billing UI (breakdown by route + model).

Kate (ops): Backend needs: route_id, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_version exported to telemetry. UI tile + drilldown required.

Samir K: We already emit per-request metadata in traces but aggregators drop route tags. We can flip a flag to preserve route tags for selected routes.

Alex M: Lightweight proto: new metric route.cost_tokens with labels {route, model}. Console can convert to $ using model price table. No PII.

Priya R: Launch criteria suggestion: 1) Per-route cost metric ingested for top 100 routes; 2) Deterministic 99th trace capture behind canary flag for top 10; 3) Docs + runbook; 4) Cost regression alert (>20% MoM).

Elaine: Instrument QPS and tail latency mapping to cost buckets. If 99th trace capture increases token usage >30% we auto-disable and notify.

Kate (ops): Dependencies: telemetry schema change, runtime flag to keep route tags, console tile + detail page, billing calc update. Rough estimate: backend 2 engs x 2 sprints, frontend 1 eng x 1 sprint, docs 0.5 sprint.

Alex M: Risks: sampling mismatch (24h window may miss anomalies), data blowup if wrong route selection, customers will want CSV export.

Samir K: Mitigations: default to conservative set (top 10 by token-volume), opt-in for customers to add routes, per-org quota to cap trace token spend.

Priya R: Customer pilot offer to Qonto: 24h deterministic window + cost cap + weekly sync. If pilot successful fold into GA requirements.

Alex M: UX note: console tile should show "estimated $/24h" with toggle "show token breakdown" and link to raw traces.

Kate (ops): For billing calc we need model price table versioning exposed in telemetry and docs.

Elaine: Add an alert "unexpected trace token surge" routed to oncall + account manager. Include top-N routes and token delta so its actionable.

Priya R: Action items: Priya -> draft pilot SOW for Qonto by Wed; Samir -> prototype runtime flag + metric emit by EOW; Alex -> mock console tile by Tue; Kate -> scope billing calc change and estimate. Ill schedule 30m sync Friday.

deploy-bot: reminder - create sprint ticket "obs: per-route cost metric" when ready (link placeholder).
